quotes.text: Learn how to accept Boleto, a common payment method in Brazil.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: After submitting the Checkout form successfully, the customer is redirected to the `hosted_voucher_url`.
The Boleto voucher has expired, or the payment has failed for some other reason.
When a Boleto voucher is created successfully, the value of the returned PaymentIntent’s `status` property is `requires_action`.
Boleto vouchers can’t be canceled before expiration.

findings: The 2026-11-07 new raw is a 17-line variant index only: Checkout, Elements via Checkout Sessions API or Payment Intents API, and Direct API (new raw lines 5-17). The 2026-05-07 old capture is a detailed multi-variant guide (old raw lines 8-1625). The diff deletes that detail from this capture and inserts navigation (diff lines 3-1630); it does not document a behavioral revision.

The existing source accurately lists four paths (wiki/sources/source-stripe-boleto-accept-payment.md:17; new raw lines 13-17), but its dated raw link and details are from the May capture (source lines 4-7,38), not revalidated by the November index.

In the older Checkout flow, form submission and checkout.session.completed create a voucher, not a paid order; checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded or the PaymentIntent succeeded state supports fulfillment, while async_payment_failed covers expiry or another failure (old raw lines 171-197). Direct API confirmation creates a voucher and returns requires_action, then payment_intent.succeeded is sent the next business day for a voucher that was paid, with funds not immediately available (old raw lines 1454-1478).

Direct API billing details include name, email, CPF or CNPJ tax_id and Brazilian address fields (old raw lines 1331-1345). The existing source omits these prerequisites (source lines 17-34) and also omits nonrefundability and the inability to cancel a voucher before expiry (old raw lines 232-238,1621-1625).

The May Checkout Sessions API Elements variant says live Pay redirects to the Boleto website (old raw lines 738-742); the Payment Intents API Elements variant says the same (old raw lines 1270-1274), and its client-side stripe.confirmPayment uses a return_url for redirects (old raw lines 1103-1109). These are distinct from the Checkout hosted_voucher_url redirect and Direct API default Stripe.js voucher modal (old raw lines 171-175,1412-1414). The November index names variants but does not renew those UI behaviors (new raw lines 11-17).

The May Direct API variant recommends client-side stripe.confirmBoletoPayment with a PaymentIntent client secret and default voucher modal, but also documents optional server-side PaymentIntent confirmation with confirm: true and Boleto billing/tax ID data (old raw lines 1412-1414,1581-1613). The mapped source line 30 must not make its client method sound exclusive; neither old route is renewed by the November variant index (new raw lines 11-17).

The related concept routes this source and repeats the four paths and delayed webhook claims (wiki/concepts/stripe-vouchers.md:41-55,115); its broad 'No redirect required' statement at line 21 needs qualification against Checkout hosted_voucher_url and live Elements Boleto-site redirects in old raw lines 171-175,738-742,1270-1274.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Dated 2026-05-07 Checkout details: Brazil/BRL and payment/subscription mode matrix, hosted voucher redirect, 0-60 calendar-day expires_after_days with default 3 and Sao Paulo 23:59 expiry, and distinct completed/async succeeded/async failed states (old raw lines 18-36,104-106,171-197). These are not independently renewed by new raw lines 9-17.

Dated 2026-05-07 Elements details: both Checkout Sessions API and Payment Intents API live Pay flows redirect to the Boleto website; the Payment Intents API client confirmPayment call uses return_url (old raw lines 738-742,1103-1109,1270-1274). These differ from the hosted Checkout voucher redirect and are not renewed by new raw lines 9-17.

Dated 2026-05-07 Direct API details: required customer billing fields and tax ID, recommended client-side confirmBoletoPayment voucher creation with requires_action and default modal, optional server-side PaymentIntent confirmation, optional hosted_voucher_url via next_action, succeeded event next business day after voucher payment, and delayed funds (old raw lines 1331-1345,1412-1460,1472-1483,1581-1613). New raw lines 9-17 are navigation only.

Dated 2026-05-07 limitations: Boleto payments cannot be refunded or disputed by the customer; vouchers cannot be canceled before expiration, then the PaymentIntent returns to requires_payment_method for another confirmation or cancellation (old raw lines 232-238,1621-1625).
conflicts: Current source summary line 13 says 'Customer redirects to hosted_voucher_url' without the Checkout scope; the old guide says Checkout redirects there (old raw lines 171-175), live Elements Pay redirects to the Boleto website in both API variants (old raw lines 738-742,1270-1274), and Direct API defaults to a Stripe.js voucher modal with hosted link separately (old raw lines 1412-1415,1458-1460). Qualify the summary and concept line 21 together.

Current source line 30 names stripe.confirmBoletoPayment without noting the old Direct API optional server-side confirmation path (old raw lines 1581-1613); the former is the recommended client-side route, not an exclusive Direct API implementation.

Current source summary line 13 says 'Payment confirmed next business day'; the old guide states payment_intent.succeeded is sent next business day for vouchers already paid, and funds are not immediately available (old raw lines 1472-1478). Distinguish voucher creation, customer payment, event, and funds availability; the November index makes no timing claim (new raw lines 9-17).
Current source line 22 equates checkout.session.async_payment_failed with voucher expiry alone; the older guide also names failure for another reason (old raw lines 191-197).
unresolved_questions: The linked November Checkout, Elements/Checkout Sessions API, Elements/Payment Intents API, and Direct API variant pages have not been captured here. New raw lines 11-17 cannot establish whether their detailed requirements, SDK behavior, defaults, or limitations changed since the May guide.

findings: Preserve the source's May 2026 provenance and four path inventory; add the November 2026 index as navigation-only provenance rather than substituting it for the old guide (source lines 4-7,17,38; new raw lines 9-17).

Scope hosted_voucher_url redirect to Checkout; distinguish the May Elements Checkout Sessions API and Payment Intents API live Boleto-site redirects and the latter's client confirmPayment return_url (old raw lines 738-742,1103-1109,1270-1274) from the Direct API default Stripe.js modal (old raw lines 1412-1414). State Direct API billing/tax ID prerequisites and optional server-side PaymentIntent confirmation alongside the recommended client-side confirmBoletoPayment path (old raw lines 1331-1345,1581-1613). Preserve nonrefundability and no cancellation before expiry, and distinguish paid voucher webhook from creation or immediate funds availability (old raw lines 171-197,232-238,1472-1483,1621-1625; source lines 13,19-22,30).
conflicts: Source line 13 unscoped redirect and confirmation phrasing can imply all four paths share the same redirect or that voucher creation is payment; Checkout hosted voucher, live Elements Boleto-site redirect, and Direct API default modal differ (old raw lines 171-197,738-742,1270-1274,1412-1478). The concept's line 21 no-redirect claim requires the reciprocal qualification.
Source line 30 must not imply client-side confirmBoletoPayment is the only Direct API path; old raw lines 1581-1613 document optional server-side PaymentIntent confirmation.
Source line 22 narrows async failure to expiry; old raw line 197 includes other failures.
source_assessments.reason: The raw delta is navigation-only, but the existing summary has material scope and state inaccuracies plus omitted operational limitations, requiring a dated accuracy update rather than inferred November behavioral replacement.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto/accept-a-payment, the complete November capture establishes only that Boleto is a Brazil payment method and that four linked variants exist: Checkout, Elements with Checkout Sessions API, Elements with Payment Intents API, and Direct API (new raw lines 5-17). It provides no detailed prerequisites or payment outcome rules. The May guide supplies dated evidence: Brazil/BRL; Checkout voucher creation on form submission and hosted_voucher_url redirect, with later async success or failure (old raw lines 18-36,171-197); both Elements variants' live Pay redirect to the Boleto website, with the Payment Intents API client confirmPayment return_url (old raw lines 738-742,1103-1109,1270-1274); and Direct API required CPF/CNPJ/address, recommended client-side confirmBoletoPayment with default voucher modal, optional server-side PaymentIntent confirmation, requires_action voucher state, and later succeeded event only after payment (old raw lines 1331-1345,1412-1478,1581-1613). The mapped source-stripe-boleto-accept-payment.md captures the paths but overgeneralizes the redirect and next-business-day confirmation, omits Elements redirect and the optional server confirmation, and omits key fields and voucher limitations (source lines 13-34).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto/accept-a-payment, the 2026-11-07 change is presentation/navigation: the new capture indexes UI and API variants without describing revised payment behavior (new raw lines 9-17). No substantive change is established. The detailed May claims remain dated: Checkout's hosted-voucher redirect and voucher-generated versus paid webhooks; both live Elements variants' Boleto-site redirect and the Payment Intents API confirmPayment return_url; Direct API's recommended client-side confirmBoletoPayment with default modal, optional server-side confirmation and optional hosted link; required tax ID/address, no refunds or pre-expiry cancellation, and a next-business-day succeeded event only after payment (old raw lines 171-197,232-238,738-742,1103-1109,1270-1274,1331-1345,1412-1478,1581-1625). In source-stripe-boleto-accept-payment.md, the unscoped redirect, payment-confirmed wording, expiry-only failure and exclusive-sounding client route need correction (source lines 13,22,30); the voucher concept's broad no-redirect wording needs a reciprocal Checkout and Elements qualification. The unread new variant bodies cannot establish changed UI, SDK/version, client/server, settlement, or outcome behavior.
